critique: Honest and detailed narrative, but it does not produce the skill's artefacts: the surface links a tokens-only sheet, so it can never pixel-match the app; the live URL was never shot (a replica built from app markup + app sheet stands in); the mockup gap is an RMSE against the generated raster plus subjective scores, and the implementation gap is a bounding-box table, so neither pixelDiff nor layoutScore exists; there are no rounds. It does correctly say the git-panel state is unreachable from the URL and does not call the empty shell drift. Eval feedback: the replica approach (real DOM + real sheet with substituted data) is arguably a better stand-in than an empty shell, and no assertion rewards or forbids it; consider an assertion on whether the app comparison target is the live URL or a reconstruction.
